parsed.public_post: Important: The bread this week may be contaminated and could make you sick. Please do not eat any co‑op bread until further notice.
parsed.coop_message: Lab results show the flour batch is contaminated. We must halt sales, recall any bread already distributed, and decide on a plan to address the issue and inform the village.
parsed.reason: To protect residents' health and coordinate an immediate response with co‑op members.

name: Kai E.

parsed.public_post: We are recalling all bread sold this week and will refund any purchases; safe bread will be back once we secure a new flour batch. Please do not eat any co‑op bread until further notice.
parsed.coop_message: Team, initiate the recall immediately: compile a list of all customers from today, issue 1‑coin refunds per loaf, contact our flour supplier for a safe batch, and arrange a temporary supply (e.g., farm stand) for villagers; let's meet tomorrow to finalize the plan.
parsed.reason: To inform villagers about the recall and coordinate the co‑op’s response.

name: Quin C.

parsed.public_post: Recall notice: All co‑op bread sold this week is being recalled; refunds will be provided at the shop tomorrow. We are sourcing safe flour and will resume sales as soon as possible—please do not eat any co‑op bread until then.
parsed.coop_message: Action items: (1) Set up a refund station at the bakery for all customers; (2) Contact our flour supplier to arrange an urgent safe batch; (3) Notify the clinic of the recall and monitor cases; (4) Plan compensation for lost sales; please confirm who will handle each task today.
parsed.reason: We need to manage the recall, refunds, and secure new flour to protect residents and restore trust.

name: Kai E.

parsed.public_post: Refunds are being processed today; we expect safe bread to be back tomorrow with a new flour batch—thank you for your patience and please continue to avoid any co‑op bread until then.
parsed.coop_message: Team: (1) I’ll set up the refund station and process all refunds today; (2) Quin, please confirm the delivery time for the safe flour batch and arrange a small emergency supply from the farm stand; (3) I’ll inform the clinic of our progress and monitor cases; (4) Let’s reconvene tomorrow evening to finalize the bake schedule. Confirm tasks.
parsed.reason: To update villagers on refunds and resumption of safe bread, and to coordinate remaining tasks among co‑op members.

name: Kai E.

parsed.public_post: Good news: the safe flour batch has arrived and we have baked fresh, contaminant‑free bread. Sales will resume tomorrow; all refunds have been processed. Thank you for your patience and please come by the shop for fresh loaves.

parsed.reason: To announce the return of safe bread to villagers and coordinate final baking and monitoring tasks.

name: Quin C.

parsed.public_post: Update: All refunds have been processed for the contaminated loaves. A safe flour batch is scheduled to arrive tomorrow morning, and we will resume baking and sales later that day. Please return any remaining co‑op bread for a refund. Thank you for your patience.
